facts.business: IFB Agro Industries Limited is engaged in the business of alcohol (distillery and bottling), marine shrimp processing, and aquaculture feed (shrimp and fish feed) manufacturing.

guidance_or_targets.statement: With the integration of the newly acquired Aqua Feed business, we expect to strengthen our market presence in all the states, improve margins, and generate sustainable value for our stakeholders. We will also focus on optimising capacity utilisation of the acquired facilities and exploring further expansion opportunities.
During the current financial year, focus will be to grow the business and achieve break even.

auditor.name: M S K A & Associates LLP

key_risks: Intermittent stoppage of production at Distillery due to high stock and reluctance of customers to lift material due to illegal methods adopted by State Excise authorities
Adverse impact on IML business due to illegal interference of Excise Authorities at District level
Margin pressure in Aqua Feed business due to abnormal increase in raw material prices which could not be passed on due to price control from AP Government
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable, and details have been disclosed in the standalone financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
